proposal.summary: Integer overflow in Exynos Mobile Processor 980 and 2100 can result in a buffer index issue that prevents execution of requested services when triggered by a crafted application.
proposal.cwe_quote: An integer overflow at a buffer index

A.quote: prevent the execution of requested services

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request full vendor advisory or technical report with reproduction steps, PoC code or crash logs to confirm impact and determine required privileges and attack vector; obtain affected firmware/software versions and mitigation status.

evidence_quotes.quote: An integer overflow at a buffer index can prevent the execution of requested services via a crafted application.
